mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO creator_post_favorite (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM creator_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_post SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE creator_post SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.slug, p.title, p.excerpt, p.cover_url, p.kind, p.status, p.version, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.published_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM creator_post_favorite f INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = f.post_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_post_favorite f INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = f.post_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
